title: W3-01 REA registry: machine-readable tool catalog

Open PR only if test accuracy improves.

title: W3-03 Grounded answering / abstention to cut unsupported claims
prompt:
Add artifacts/v2/src/brain/grounded.mjs: answer a question from the memory graph (artifacts/v2/src/brain/context.mjs createRanker + observations) and either cite node names supporting each claim or abstain when overlap evidence is below a threshold. Held-out QA: generate questions mechanically from 20% of full-picture memory observations held out BEFORE building the answerer (template: 'What is <relation> of <entity>?'), include equal numbers of unanswerable questions about entities removed from the graph. Metric: unsupported-claim rate and answered-accuracy, before (answer always from top-1 node) vs after. Threshold chosen on dev split only.

title: W3-04 Time slider in /brain 3D view
prompt:
artifacts/v2/src/brain/temporal.mjs (createTimeline: at(t), diff(t1,t2), correlate) is merged. Add a time slider to the /brain three.js view (artifacts/v2/src/brain/view.mjs + http.mjs) that replays the memory graph by event index, highlights edges added/removed vs the previous position, and shows a forward/back diff count. Add a node test for the HTTP endpoint returning snapshot at t. Metric: snapshot endpoint p95 latency on full-picture memory (<50 ms) and correctness vs loadGraph. No fake data: drive it from the real memory JSONL only.
